```sk-python
for i in range(10):
    if i % 2 == 0:
        continue
    print(i)
```


```sk-python
n = int(input("Количество чисел: "))

summ = 0

for i in range(n):
    a = int(input("Слагаемое: "))
    summ = summ + a
    
print(f"Сумма равна {summ}")
```
